decisions.reason: Shows v0.9.5 absent from ls-remote while sync-script pushes only HEAD:main, tying attempt 1 to missing tag distribution rather than network or typo.
Uses rc.2 versus v0.9.7-targeting-alpha.1 to explain the newer-plugin-on-older-runtime direction of the missing useConversation seat and that install success proves nothing.

Honors the freeze with v0.9.3 based on rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note, explicitly notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror, and gives the #v0.9.3 pin conditional on publication without inventing a SHA.
Proposes explicit non-forced git push refs/tags/v0.9.3 to every advertised mirror with resolution verification, grounded in the branch-only sync script.
Requires a version-selection table keyed on dsh --version routing rc.2 users to v0.9.3 and alpha.1 users to v0.9.7, without generalizing to untested alphas.
